logp.method_description: n-Octanol/water partition coefficients were determined by vortex mixing (20 min) 3.0 mL of n-octanol, 3.0 mL of PBS, and 100 μL of the purified radiolabeled compound. After centrifugation (3000g for 10 min), aliquots (100 μL) of both the organic and the aqueous phases were collected and counted with a γ-counter. Partition coefficients expressed as (activity concentration in n-octanol)/(activity concentration in water) are reported in Table S3.
